literal_meaning: মাথায় বজ্রপাত হওয়া (To be struck by a thunderbolt on the head)
figurative_meaning_en: To receive a sudden and massive blow
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবর শুনে তার মাথায় বজ্রাঘাত হয়েছে।
ব্যবসায়ের ক্ষতি হলে মাথায় বজ্রাঘাতের মতো ধাক্কা লাগে।
example_sentences_in_english: Hearing the news felt like a thunderbolt to his head.
The business loss hit him like a thunderbolt on the head.
history: The idiom draws from the natural phenomenon of lightning strikes in rural Bengal, symbolizing unforeseen calamities in folklore and oral traditions.
note: The imagery evokes the power of nature, common in Bengali expressive language.
